claim_text: Evidence for beta-alanine is protocol- and outcome-specific; findings from repeated high-intensity efforts should not be generalized to all endurance-only activity.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported supplementation and support context-specific evidence interpretation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food sources and relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet summarizes beta-alanine evidence by exercise type and duration.
limitations: No universal performance benefit or dose established.
Underlying evidence and exact source passages require full appraisal before approval.
